theorems.statement: ∀ (N k : ℕ) (β : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid (N + 1))) (k + 1)) (θ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k), (∀ (x : Euclid N) (v : Fin k → Euclid N), (θ : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) x v = ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, (β : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) (k + 1)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))) (Fin.cons (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i)))))) → ∀ (x : Euclid N) (v : Fin (k + 1) → Euclid N), ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, exteriorDerivative (β : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) (k + 1)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))) (Fin.cons (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i))))) = (β : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) (k + 1)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 1 (WithLp.ofLp x))) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i)))) - (β : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) (k + 1)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp x))) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i)))) - exteriorDerivative (θ : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) x v
